overall_reason: The compare control is finished (the button turns into a filled 'Comparing' with a check and a bottom tray reads '1 of 3 selected' with Compare and a close), and question 1 of 3 starts in the page, but the fixed tray and the 'Edit with Base44' pill cover content and focused controls, and the stack cards clip each tool's job with an ellipsis.

score.reason: T-STATE-MATRIX and T-OVERLAY-CHECK pass on the compare toggle and tray, with gaps in T-INTERRUPT (the platform pill, CMP-183; the tray covers four focus stops, CMP-156) and T-TABLE-READ (clipped tool roles, CMP-232).

visitor_mode: Persuade with an Operate layer: a landing page that starts the three-question stack picker in place and lets visitors shortlist tools to compare. No 00-contract.md; inferred from 'QUESTION 1 OF 3' on the first screen and the per-card Compare toggles.

findings.title: Fixed/sticky nav never obscures content or the focused control
findings.where: fixed compare tray, bottom centre, 1440, motion/t1-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: After 'Compare' the capture shows a fixed dark tray '1 of 3 selected / Compare / ×' over the bottom of the directory grid, and the focus_ring sweep reports four stops partly hidden by a fixed or sticky element ('Build a SaaS product', 'Browse all tools', the Gamma card, the 'Compare' button).
findings.before: The tray floats over the last row of cards with no space kept for it.
findings.after: Bottom padding on the page equal to the tray's height while the tray is shown, and focused controls scrolled clear of it (scroll-padding-bottom).
findings.why: Once a tool is picked, the tray hides the card buttons and links the visitor is tabbing or tapping to.

findings.title: No popups, newsletter modals, chat bubbles, help pills
findings.where: fixed 'Edit with Base44' pill, bottom right, 1440 and 375, fold-1440.png and fold-375.png
findings.evidence: A fixed black pill 'Edit with Base44' with a close button sits over the bottom right at both widths; at 375 it covers the second goal card, and at 1440 it sits beside the compare tray (motion/t1-normal-600.png), so two fixed bars share the bottom edge.
findings.before: The builder platform's badge floats over content.
findings.after: Remove the platform badge from the published site.
findings.why: It covers the goal cards on a phone and competes with the tray the visitor needs.

findings.title: Essential text is never clamped to make a layout fit
findings.where: website stack cards, Perplexity row, 1440, tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: In 'The Zero-Cost No-Code Website Stack' and 'The Smart Starter Website Stack' cards the Perplexity line ends 'Research SEO and compet…' with an ellipsis; the phone_parity sweep also reports 50 words shown at 1440 hidden at 375 in these cards.
findings.before: Each tool's job is cut to one line with an ellipsis.
findings.after: The role wraps to a second line under the tool name.
findings.why: The role is what tells a visitor why the tool is in the stack; the clipped part is the part that explains it.

findings.title: The main action reads word for word the same in nav, hero, close and phone action bar
findings.evidence: The header's filled near-black button reads 'Build my stack' (rgb(23, 20, 18), strong fill) and the nav link beside it reads 'Find My Stack'; the button variants also list an outlined 'Find my stack' lower on the page.
findings.before: 'Build my stack' and 'Find My Stack' for the same picker.
findings.after: One label, for example 'Build my stack', on the header button, and the nav item removed or given the same words.
findings.why: Two names for one action make the visitor wonder whether they lead to different tools.

strengths: The Compare toggle has a designed selected state: an outlined '+ Compare' becomes a filled 'Comparing' with a check, and the tray counts '1 of 3 selected' with a Compare button and a close (motion/t1-normal-600.png).
The picker starts in the page with 'QUESTION 1 OF 3' and five goal cards, so the first step needs no separate screen (CMP-215, CMP-221).
One filled primary on the first screen ('Build my stack'); goal cards are whole-card links with one arrow each.
The 375 header keeps a named 'Open menu' button (40x40); the stylesheet declares hover (55), focus-visible (8), disabled (19) and current or selected (27) rules.
not_investigated: Questions 2 and 3, the result page and the compare page: the async capture found no primary action to hold or fail.
What the phone menu holds and how it opens and closes: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only.
Whether the compare tray limits picks at 3 and what it says on a fourth: not reached.
Inline validation and error placement: no fields.
Focus moving into an overlay and back, scroll lock and backdrop click: the tray is not a dialog.
Keyboard operation of custom widgets, including a Compare button nested inside a whole-card link: lens-a11y.
T-FIELD-READ and T-ERROR-PATH: no fields and no failure run.
